current.text: He is projected to start at power forward for Milwaukee to open the season.
Do not draft him inside the top 200, even as a projected starter.
Milwaukee lost Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the frontcourt, which should give him more minutes.
Milwaukee's starting lineup could change by December or March. The team is expected to focus more on young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes.
Milwaukee needs trades to consolidate its roster, and he is named as one of the players who do not fit well.
Taylor Jenkins is Milwaukee's new head coach and might use a deep rotation. Experts have low confidence in how the Bucks will split minutes.

durable.text: He is a poor free throw shooter with poor steals and blocks. He does not make threes at high volume or a high percentage.
He is a mediocre role player.
His projected category line is close to the pool average everywhere and has no strong category. Blocks and FT% are his weakest.

note: At Yahoo rank 196 and ESPN rank 224, with 0 USD values on both sites, he is well outside the 144 players we draft, and the expert would not take him inside the top 200. Yahoo's projection is kinder than ESPN's: 1.1 steals and 1.2 TO against 0.6 and 1.8. ESPN's line matches last season's 0.7 steals and 1.7 TO in 26.2 minutes. Leave him on waivers and check early whether he keeps the starting power forward job and plays clearly more than 26 minutes.
